name: USB Non Rechargeable Mini Air Humidifier for Bedroom – High Power, Ultra-Quiet, with Color Lights (H2O)
description:
This lightweight mini mist diffuser is compact and portable, making it perfect for bedrooms, offices, living rooms, cars, and more.

Fresh and Moisturized Air: Keeps the room air fresh and adds moisture for a comfortable environment.

Ultra-Quiet Operation: Designed with low noise, ensuring it won’t disturb you or others.

Easy to Use: Features a one-key switch and colorful atmosphere lighting to enhance your space.

Aromatherapy Support: Add water-soluble essential oils to enjoy a pleasant fragrance in your room.

Specifications ⚙️

Regular Shutdown: 4 hours / 6 hours

Material: ABS + Silicone, Electronic Components

Capacity: 300ml

Rated Input: DC 5.0V, 1.0A

Size: 78 x 78 x 119 mm

Working Current: 250–350 mA

Spray Volume: 30–45 mL/h

Note ⚠️

Colors may slightly vary due to different screen resolutions.

Minor measurement errors may occur due to manual measurement.

Package Includes 📦

1 x Humidifier

1 x USB Cable

2 x Cotton Swabs

1 x User Manual
